title: PoliCon: Evaluating LLMs on Achieving Diverse Political Consensus Objectives
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It evaluated the ability of LLMs to draft consensus resolutions on diverse political objectives based on deliberation records from the European Parliament.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on political consensus, political party stances, and governance within the European Parliament.
